body.title: Wire attachments into the extension
body.summary: vscode.d.ts: declare window.showOpenDialog. extension.ts: build the store on join(PATHS.insrc, 'chat-attachments'); inject pickFiles (showOpenDialog with canSelectMany, returning fsPath values, none when dismissed) and open (the vscode.open command on a file URI); remove a session's attachments in onEvict beside its output files; sweep at start with the same keep set and age as the output sweep. Update extension-chat-wiring.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: The store is built on ~/.insrc/chat-attachments and the picker and opener are injected into the chat host
onEvict removes a session's attachments and its output files; the start-up sweep uses the same keep set
The plugin type-checks with showOpenDialog declared and the wiring test passes

tests.name: extension wiring: the store is built on ~/.insrc/chat-attachments, the picker and opener are injected, onEvict removes a session's attachments and the start-up sweep uses the same keep set
